name: opus3_razorqs_audit_uho_example
comment: AUDIT-ONLY protocol for QA's UHO confirmation gate (the primary route, confirm/PROPOSED_QA_ENTRY.json). Use it only with bin\confirm.ps1 -Command audit -Protocol <this file> -Candidate <cand.json> -Pgn <QA's gate PGN>. The run/registry fields are absent on purpose: the gate is played and decided by QA's own runner, and this file only drives the independent recomputation. Before the audit, QA must: (1) make sprt equal the gate's own SPRT (cap_games 40000 if QA used the proposed cap; a mismatch makes the recomputation disagree, which fails safe and makes no claim); (2) set qa_gate to the engine names in the gate PGN; (3) set training_config_sha256 to the RUN.json config_sha256 of the complete live tuning run. Claim only if QA's verdict and this recomputation agree, leakage <= 1% and candidate_issues is empty.
training_config_sha256: QA_FILLS_BEFORE_THE_AUDIT: RUN.json config_sha256 of the complete live tuning run
